title: "Per-page macro dependencies"
format: math-web-html
math-web:
  macros:
    - example-macros.sty
    - extra-macros.sty
---

This page uses just one custom command:

$$\plane$$

The generated configuration contains `\plane` and its dependency `\RR`.
The declarations for `\pair`, `\rankop`, and `\shift` are omitted from this
page, even though the other examples use them.

Mentioning commands in inline code or a code block does not retain them:

```latex
\pair{x}{y}
\rankop(A)
```

For commands used by dynamically inserted math, add their names to
`math-web.include`; their dependencies will also be retained. Set
`math-web.filter: false` to emit every imported definition.
